# LeoECS Lite source provenance

The `src/*.cs` files and `LICENSE.md` in this directory are a pinned copy of
the existing Unity package dependency. They are not an upgrade or a fork.

- Source repository: https://github.com/Leopotam/ecslite
- Pinned commit: `d46f3b209ea163810823aeea7d2610d38ad6cdf8`
- Existing Unity dependency: `com.leopotam.ecslite` in `Packages/manifest.json`
- Local package source: `Library/PackageCache/com.leopotam.ecslite@d46f3b209ea1`

Only the runtime C# source files required by `TankDraft.Game.Core` and the
upstream license are copied here. Unity `.asmdef` files, `.meta` files, editor
files, and the package Git metadata are intentionally excluded.
